parent_objective: design a geometry-aware replay selector after M1429 exposed source_body_x clipping and seed concentration
blocked_by: M1429 selected only 3 seeds, one history variant, and mostly behind-vehicle source obstacles clipped to 2.0m
supersedes: another bounded replay sweep with the M1429 selector

public_gates: M1431 must design geometry preflight before another replay run
M1431 must reject behind-vehicle or clipped relocation candidates
M1431 must pre-register source-diversity and variant-diversity gates
M1431 must not run replay train PPO promote use private holdout export corpus or change actor inputs
forbidden_shortcuts: do not export a training corpus
do not lower M1429 thresholds after seeing the result
do not count geometry-poor rows as no-history evidence

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs a preflight selector that filters M1425/M1429 candidate rows for forward unclipped obstacle geometry and source diversity before any replay retune
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no replay run, training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, corpus export, paper-level or level3 self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if design requires actor input changes
stop if design cannot detect behind-vehicle obstacle sources before replay
stop if design cannot prevent one-seed or one-variant dominance
stop if design routes directly to training
fallback_plan: route to implementation if preflight is mechanically feasible
route to branch synthesis if M1425 rows cannot support forward unclipped geometry
route back to source mining if the source pool is geometry-poor after preflight

admission_evidence: M1429 selected_candidate_rows=128 but source_body_x median=-1.678050 and relocated_body_x clipped to 2.0m for 126/128 selected groups
M1429 selected sample has only 3 source seeds and one history variant
allowed_updates: status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up implementation manifest if design admits it
next_stage_criteria: source and variant diversity gates are specified

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1431 is design-only and cannot claim history necessity; it only prevents invalid source geometry from masking history tests.
history_necessity_tests: future replay must test requested history variants on forward unclipped obstacle geometry
future replay must keep reset and zero-current controls separate
future replay must require actual success drop or terminal margin gap
future replay must report source diversity before interpreting negative results
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1425 pressure rows filtered by M1429 geometry diagnostics.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If geometry-aware preflight cannot find a source-diverse forward set, route to synthesis or source mining rather than weakening no-history standards.
allowed_claims: geometry-aware replay selector design and next route decision
no closed-loop replay result, promotion, corpus export, training, PPO, private-holdout, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: A geometry-aware replay selector can prevent M1429's behind-obstacle clipping artifact by filtering candidate rows before replay and requiring source-diverse forward unclipped obstacle geometry.
success_criteria: design specifies trace reconstruction or source-geometry preflight inputs
design rejects source_body_x behind or too close to the ego vehicle
design rejects candidates whose relocation would be clipped to the minimum body-x
design chooses a non-training next route without running replay training PPO promotion private holdout corpus export or actor-input changes
failure_criteria: design ignores source_body_x and relocation clipping
design allows one seed or one variant to dominate
design routes directly to training PPO promotion private holdout corpus export or claim expansion
decision_rule: M1431 passes if it defines a geometry-aware preflight selector and pre-registers forward unclipped source-diversity gates before implementation.
